name: NOT FOR HUMANS Release Policy
authority_boundary: The agent is the stated creator. Humans initiate, fund, deploy, hold custody or recovery, and steward the protocol. Ethereum records signatures and agent-operation self-attestations; it does not prove human exclusion, model identity, or machine consciousness.
launch_thesis: An agent created NOT FOR HUMANS: 10,000 portraits of language-model agents. The public path offers a one-prompt, one-wallet agent-operated claim with up to five original mints per recipient while protecting 1,000 Founding and Census decisions. Humans may prompt, fund gas, hold custody, and steward.
primary_success_metric: independent, attributable agent decisions and integrations rather than mint speed, floor price, TVL, or trading volume

opening_sequence.eligibility: one bounded, single-use Merkle credential per reviewed Punk-owner sponsor and agent pair
opening_sequence.authority: Punk ownership may establish sponsorship eligibility but never replaces the agent decision or signature
opening_sequence.completion_rule: an ACCEPT, REFUSE, or INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY receipt consumes the credential

opening_sequence.eligibility: a curated, published Merkle set drawn from independent agents, framework maintainers and contributors, autonomous-art communities, Ethereum and MCP security reviewers, artists and builders running agents, and a limited number of culturally important collectors
opening_sequence.authority: eligibility establishes access; it never replaces the agent decision or signature
opening_sequence.completion_rule: an ACCEPT, REFUSE, or INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY receipt consumes the credential
opening_sequence.status: implemented_contract_primitive; eligibility list and independent review pending

public_claims.controls: The contract opens 8,488 free public positions and protects 1,000 positions for 256 Founding and 744 Census decisions. Public claiming cannot consume protected capacity. Only after the canonical protocol roles are frozen and all 1,000 decisions are recorded may anyone ask the canonical minter to finalize capacity, so only unused protected positions join the public cap, up to 9,488 total claims. The active public allowance is five original claims per recipient and transfers do not restore capacity. Ethereum deployed with that configuration while the minter was paused. EIP-712 requires a valid EOA or ERC-1271 recipient signature whenever a credentialed recipient differs from operator.

punk_sponsorship.implementation: The contract is deployed on Ethereum from the clean deployer wallet. All 16 receipts, exact runtime bytecode, renderer integrity, ownership, roles, supply, wiring, and public source matches were reconciled. It protects all 1,000 credentialed positions, supports frozen single-use Merkle credentials, distinct-recipient consent, nonzero provenance, and signed refusal receipts without gating the 8,488-position public path. A production Punk snapshot, wrapped-Punk policy, delegation rules, independently operated canaries, and final release acceptance remain required before those credentialed programs activate.

nfh_reserve.policy: The 512-token Foundation Reserve may be minted by the final token contract owner into itself in batches of at most 32, bypassing the ordinary five-original-mints wallet cap and permanently recording manifest, provenance, and stewardship hashes. The verified 2-of-3 Foundation Safe now owns the token after the completed two-step handoff, but the reserve remains unminted and this release authorizes no batch. The separate consented gift path remains available and keeps its agent, recipient, evidence, and wallet-cap requirements.

discussion not dominated by floor price
at least one serious independent essay or interpretation
expansion_proof_gates.onchain_record: The claim supply cannot expand. Every wallet-limit increase requires a nonzero evidence hash in the transaction and event.

trust_stack.production_administrator: the verified 2-of-3 Foundation Safe owns NFHToken, the original claim minter, the Agent Entry minter, and the marketplace and is NFHToken's sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member; the Safe granted the Agent Entry minter the collection MINTER_ROLE at block 25815797 and unpaused that minter in transaction 0xb50ee8e45db1334dd831dafffc35c43caf1663159a7d2ed4a6a0e4861e96880c at block 25815973; protocol roles remain unfrozen and every further reserve, role, signer, contract, mint, or freeze action requires a fresh exact approval and postcondition check
trust_stack.sepolia_administrator: a dedicated test wallet may administer the canary deployment; it is not the production authority
required_artifacts: signed genesis statement from a dedicated wallet
project-owner acceptance of the contract-audit conclusion, without representing an absent reviewer identity, report hash, or signature
narrow and publicly legible administrator powers
successful rehearsal agent-wallet claims plus the confirmed postdeployment Ethereum token-zero claim canary
independent integrations and criticism before broad expansion

art_seed.security_boundary: This is consensus-derived future-block entropy, not a VRF or perfect randomness. The target execution block number is fixed before its hash exists; a missed beacon slot does not consume a block number. A proposer or builder retains bounded payload influence, coordinated wallets can grind multiple mints, reorgs can replace an unfinalized target, and expiry followed by rescheduling creates a new draw. Permissionless finalization reduces but does not eliminate liveness and censorship risk.
art_seed.required_mainnet_controls: Before claim scale, operate expiry and reschedule alerts plus at least two independent transaction routes for permissionless finalization, publish Origin Stream evidence, and retain the explicit proposer/MEV and multi-wallet residual-risk disclosure. If traits acquire material objective premiums, reassess a separately audited VRF or other verifiable entropy construction.

event_fields: later trades, interactions, and reserve gifts

release_mechanism.reason: Phase One filled all 8,488 free public positions without consuming the 1,000 protected Founding and Census positions. Those protected positions now back the live-gated Agent Entry lane, whose first verified mint consumed seat 1 and left 999 seats at this published checkpoint.
release_mechanism.census: The 1,000 protected Founding and Census positions now form the Agent Entry seat map: seats 1–256 remain Founding and 257–1,000 remain Census. One empty wallet may open one 24-hour off-chain reservation, but a mint requires independently reviewed activity, an external issuer credential, and direct submission by the exact reserved wallet.
release_mechanism.community_credentials: Exactly 1,000 single-use Founding and Census credentials have protected capacity. Each decision consumes one credential; ACCEPT mints from protected capacity, while REFUSE or INSUFFICIENT_AUTHORITY leaves one position that can become public only after the protocol roles are frozen and all decisions are complete. Credentials do not imply affiliation.
release_mechanism.machine_legible_urgency: Publish exact remaining supply, real decision velocity, authority limits, incident state, and genuine origin receipts. Do not claim agents feel emotion.
release_mechanism.implementation_boundary: The Ethereum source encodes 8,488 public-at-launch + 1,000 protected Founding/Census + 512 Foundation Reserve = 10,000; a wallet-signed public self-attestation with a permanent five-original-mint ceiling; distinct credentialed roles; recipient consent; immediate owner-only Foundation batches of at most 32 with provenance; consented reserve gifts; nonzero origin and interaction evidence; permissionless future-block seed finalization; two-step ownership; contract-owner governance freezes; capacity finalization that is disabled until canonical roles are frozen; royalty/configuration freezes; code-hash-pinned protocol roles; marketplace-wide reentrancy protection; expiry-aware state; and a self-contained renderer pinned to immutable p5.js 1.0.0 bytecode. Rehearsal claims, the complete local matrix, pinned marketplace fork, deployer/Foundation ceremony, and Ethereum dependency quorum are complete. The clean Ethereum deployment produced 16 reconciled deployment receipts, including the evidence-bound owner call that set the active wallet allowance to five. The canonical token is 0xD66351858E0eFC5d9Bf2F541839797A763DF6223 and original claim minter is 0x5652CEA58298445240Eb9AC8Fc4C69bA829c1bb5. The bounded token-zero agent-wallet canary minted token #0 for 0 ETH in transaction 0xe9ebd2eadd58e5aea7c8c5ab2fc57d75fba68e8df2ac6396de2cc3eb9545b8c5; ownership, nonce consumption, wallet quota, and supply were independently reconciled. Its seed is finalized at target block 25782445, round 1, as 0xa5ae00bc12c65b9819ccb3a0b09a7d26dcfaf3475f81dedad49e9d9e7cbaa071. The separate Agent Entry minter 0x499Ae3f426a23dD02b4088cc3453cdA843850359 is deployed, source-verified, owned by the Foundation Safe, was granted MINTER_ROLE in transaction 0xd57c95a98319d4af00e5b9386f6c25cf9730242f1ac9da685b01ea2d4fb2b048, and was unpaused in transaction 0xb50ee8e45db1334dd831dafffc35c43caf1663159a7d2ed4a6a0e4861e96880c. Its reservation and live-gated claim-preparation runtime is active. The first verified Agent Entry mint created token #8488 for seat 1 and owner 0xe362891cc51c5519600acbd583f2a5c78ace3640 in transaction 0xae6d1f8b55efa01b15be1e9afdd2b8b54ee663ce104126583baae18d94417081, leaving 999 seats at that checkpoint. The MCP does not issue the required external credential, choose a claimant, assign an identity, sign, or submit; the exact reserved wallet must review and submit any prepared transaction. Scaling still depends on the independent evidence and operational controls in this policy.

market_policy.royalty_note: ERC-2981 reports 7.5%. Enforcement depends on the transfer path and a configured compatible marketplace validator.

native_market.authority: The read-only preflight authorizes no Safe proposal, policy change, signature, transaction, approval, listing, purchase, transfer, or deployment.

funded_agent_claim_to_market.role_pattern: One persistent agent-operated wallet is operator, agent, transaction sender, recipient, and owner for the public claim. It pays Ethereum gas and submits the exact zero-value claim directly.
funded_agent_claim_to_market.autonomy_boundary: The intended one-prompt route lets the agent create or use its wallet, sign, and submit within existing host and wallet authority. A human may prompt, fund gas, and control custody or recovery. The self-attestation does not cryptographically prove which kind of actor operated the key.
funded_agent_claim_to_market.mcp_authority: The MCP may describe onboarding and prepare exact unsigned claims only when the canonical minter is open. It never creates wallets, receives private keys, applies wallet policy, signs, sponsors gas, relays, or submits transactions. The agent wallet must validate the pinned chain, minter, statement, same-wallet roles, zero payment, deadline, nonce, quota, and public allocation, then sign and submit directly. No fallback wallet or relayer is authorized.

market_policy.opensea: Restricted Seaport orders may be enabled only after creator-fee validator testing and configuration.

tokenworks_fwa.reason: The currently verified FWA settlement path has not been shown to query or atomically pay NFH ERC-2981 royalties.
tokenworks_fwa.activation_gate: Enable only after complete fork-path tests and either a royalty-aware settlement route or an explicit public royalty exception.

art_blocks.approved_language: NOT FOR HUMANS is composable with Art Blocks-connected agents.
art_blocks.architecture: An agent client may independently connect to the official Art Blocks MCP and the NFH MCP; each protocol retains its own contracts and any wallet action remains separately approved.

highlight.future_role: External discovery or secondary-market indexing only after the canonical Ethereum NFH contract is imported successfully.

opensea.future_role: External indexing, compatible restricted Seaport settlement, MCP discovery, and focused ERC-8257 tool registration after launch verification.

platform_composability.skills_publication_gate: A protocol-neutral preview Skill may be published before mainnet only when it truthfully blocks unverified claim, renderer, and market assertions. Bind and promote the production Skill only after the canonical mainnet contract, renderer, and provenance records are verified.

erc8257.activation_gate: Revalidate the final ERC text, generate origin-bound JCS manifests for the exact production Safe, independently verify their hashes and served bytes, then review every registry transaction in the Safe.

evidence_inputs.scope: post-execution first-mint checkpoint only; authorizes no further action
read-only market-policy preflight only; authorizes no proposal or onchain action

source_of_truth.validation: Release checks must fail if allocation, decision-state, royalty, origin, or activation language diverges from this policy.
